meta.mission: 6-month aesthetic body (X-frame) — body recomposition for a 25 y/o skinny-fat beginner, Delhi NCR
meta.split: Mon Lower A / Tue Push / Wed Pull / Thu Legs+Abs / Fri Upper B / Sat-Sun Rest + walking
meta.language: Hinglish UI labels welcome (user is a Hinglish speaker)

profile.name: Athlete (Delhi NCR)
profile.experience: Beginner (pehle ~20 din normal exercise, phir gap — ab fresh restart)
profile.goal: Body recomposition / lean gain — muscle build + side belly kam. 5–6 mahine mein aesthetic X-frame body (chaude kandhe + chaudi lats + tight waist + bhare hue legs). Slight calorie surplus, NO crash diet.
profile.diet: Non-veg (4 eggs/day, chicken Sundays). Ek mahina pure veg (religious).
profile.gymTime: 7:00 PM (office ke baad, bina aaram kiye)
profile.digestion: Fiber ke saath theek; bina fiber bloating (papaya, dahi, paani help karte hain)
profile.supplementsOwned: Creatine monohydrate + Whey 1 kg (25 g protein/scoop)

expectation.honestTruth: 6 mahine mein Instagram model nahi banega — wo 1.5–2 saal ka khel hai. Lekin 6 mahine bina ek bhi hafta miss kiye train kiya toh ye milega:
results: Weight 66 → 69–70 kg (muscle ka, fat ka nahi)
Chest, shoulders, arms visibly bhare hue — T-shirt fit hone lagegi
Month 3–4 se log poochne lagenge: 'gym jaata hai kya?'
expectation.core: Asli test body ka nahi, consistency ka hai. 20-din-on / 1-week-off wala khel is baar band.
expectation.fiveDayConditions: 5-day plan tabhi kaam karega jab: (1) Neend 7 ghante minimum, (2) Khana poora, (3) Cigarette down. Ye teen nahi toh 4 din consistent zyada behtar hai 5 din adhoore se.
expectation.spotReductionTruth: Spot reduction jhooth hai — na side bends se love handles jaate hain, na 500 crunches se. Fat poore body se jaata hai: calorie balance + protein + patience. Core strength ke liye train hota hai; fat girega toh abs dikhenge. Heavy weighted side bends MAT karna — obliques mote hoke waist chaudi dikha sakte hain.

trainingRules: Har session ka opening (10 min, plan ka hissa hai): 5 min incline walk/cycle (halki saans phoole) + us din ka dynamic warm-up (~5 min) + pehli exercise ke 1–2 halke ramp-up sets.
Rest: compound lifts (squat, RDL, bench, overhead press, rows, pulldown) pe 2–3 min; isolation (curls, raises, pushdowns, calves, abs) pe 60–90 sec.
Tempo: weight neeche 2 second control se, upar power se. Gravity ko free ride nahi.
Weight kitna? Jisme last 2 reps mushkil hon par form na toote.
PROGRESSIVE OVERLOAD (growth ka engine): jab teeno sets clean form mein rep-range ke top pe lag jayen → agle session +2.5 kg. Ye nahi kiya toh 6 mahine baad bhi same body.
Pehle 2 hafte weight halka, form pakka. Apne sets phone pe record kar (side angle) — camera jhooth nahi bolta.
Session total 60–75 min (7:00–8:15 PM). Sat–Sun gym band: full rest + walking.
Roz 8,000–10,000 steps (office + dinner ke baad 15 min walk — digestion + cigarette-replacement dono).
Creatine 3–5 g HAR roz — rest day bhi.
Neend: 11–11:30 tak bed, 7 ghante minimum. Muscle gym mein TOOT-ta hai, neend mein BANTA hai.
NEVER MISS TWICE: ek din chhoota — theek hai, agla din pakka. Mood na ho toh bhi jaa, 30 min hi sahi.
universalFormRules: Spine neutral — na gol, na zyada arch. Har lift ka rule #1.
Shoulder blades ka ghar — pressing mein peeche-neeche squeeze; pulling mein pehle khulti hain, phir squeeze hoti hain.
Core braced — har rep se pehle aisa tight jaise pet pe punch aane wala ho.
Full range of motion — aadha rep = aadha muscle.
Control — neeche 2 second, upar power se.
stretchingRules: GOLDEN RULE: Exercise se PEHLE = dynamic (hilte-dulte moves). Exercise ke BAAD = static (20–30 sec pakad ke rukna). Pehle static karne se muscle dheela padta hai — strength 5–10% girti hai.
Bounce kabhi nahi — jhatke se stretch = chhoti tear ka invite. Pakad ke statue ban ja.
Khichav feel ho, dard nahi — 6/10 tak ka pull theek, uske aage backfire.
Saans chalti rahe — exhale pe thoda aur andar ja. Saans roki toh muscle akad jaata hai.
Thande muscle ko kabhi zor se static stretch mat kar — isi liye static workout ke BAAD hai.

weekendRoutine.satSun: Gym band — full rest. 10 min full-body stretch ghar pe (Monday wale saare static + doorway chest + child's pose). Soreness aadhi, Monday fresh legs.
weekendRoutine.daily: Din mein kabhi bhi: hip flexor lunge stretch + doorway chest stretch — desk job ke do sabse bade dushmanon ka roz ka ilaaj.
weekendRoutine.steps: Sat–Sun bhi 8–10k steps chalu, creatine chalu.

crowdDodgeRules: Order shuffle allowed — SAME day ke andar exercises aage-peeche kar sakta hai (bench busy? pehle fly/lateral kar, 10 min mein bench khali). Bas kisi aur DIN ka muscle mat utha lena.

Backup ready rakh: Barbell bench busy → DB bench ya machine chest press. Squat rack busy → goblet squat ya leg press pehle. Lat pulldown busy → assisted pull-up ya one-arm row pehle. Cable busy → DB se wahi kaam.
Magic line seekh le: 'Bhai kitne set bache? Saath mein kar loon?' — uske rest mein tera set, tere rest mein uska. Gym ka sabse purana jugaad.
muscleAudit: Upper chest — Tue (Incline DB Press)
Mid chest — Fri (Barbell Bench) + Tue fly/pec deck
Lats — 2× (Wed pull-up/pulldown + one-arm row; Fri lat pulldown)
Mid-back (rhomboids, mid traps) — 2× (Wed chest-supported row; Fri cable row)
Lower back (spinal erectors) — Mon (RDL)
Front delts — 2× (Tue + Fri presses)
Side delts — 2× direct (Tue cable lateral, Fri DB lateral) + 2 press days
Rear delts — 2× (Wed face pull; Fri reverse pec deck)
Upper traps — Wed (DB shrug) + Thu (farmer's carry)
Biceps — 2× (Wed EZ curl; Fri DB curl) + saare pulls
Brachialis — Wed (hammer curl)
Triceps long head — Tue (overhead extension); lateral head — Tue + Fri (pushdowns)
Forearms — 2× (Wed hammer curl; Thu farmer's carry)
Quads — 2× (Mon squat/leg press; Thu leg press/lunges/extension)
Hamstrings — 2× (Mon RDL/lying curl; Thu seated curl)
Glutes — 3× touch (squat, RDL, lunges, leg press, bridge)
Calves: Gastrocnemius — Mon (standing raise); Soleus — Thu (seated raise)
Upper abs — Thu (cable crunch); Lower abs — Thu (hanging knee raise)
Obliques — Mon (side plank)
Rotator cuff — Wed (face pull) + band pull-aparts roz
RECOVERY CHECK: Legs Mon→Thu = 72 hrs. Chest Tue→Fri = 72 hrs. Back Wed→Fri = 48 hrs (exercises alag). Koi muscle do din lagatar nahi. Sar se pair tak EK BHI muscle bina kaam ke nahi.

week.crowdNote: Sab bench pe lage hain (International Chest Day) → squat rack aur leg section khali — tu raja.

warmup.why: Ankle mobility — squat depth ka asli taala; heels uthne ki problem yahin fix hoti hai.

warmup.name: Glute bridge
warmup.why: Desk job se soye glutes ko ON karna — warna squat mein sirf quads khayenge.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.form: Bar upper traps pe, chest upar, back seedhi. Feet shoulder-width, toes thoda bahar, heels zameen pe, knees toes ki direction. Depth: hip crease ghutne ke barabar ya thoda neeche. (Form set na ho tab tak Goblet Squat.)
exercises.mistakes: Ego weight pe half squat; knees andar girna; heels uthna.
exercises.backup: Goblet Squat ya Leg Press pehle (rack busy ho toh)

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
exercises.form: Knees soft, hips PEECHE push, bar body se chipki, back bilkul FLAT (plank jaisi). Hamstring mein stretch aaya → wapas upar.
exercises.mistakes: Back round karna — ye galti MAAF NAHI. Photo/video mein pith gol dikhe toh wahi galat version hai.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.form: Full control se neeche; top pe knees lock out mat kar.
exercises.mistakes: Bahut neeche laake lower back seat se uthana; knees lock karna.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.form: Hips pad se chipke rahen, control se curl.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.form: Upar 1 sec ruk, neeche FULL stretch. Calves ziddi muscle hai — isliye 4 sets.

exercises.name: Plank + Side Plank
exercises.form: Sar se edi tak seedhi rod jaisi line, glutes squeeze, hips na latke na uthe. Side plank: elbow seedha kandhe ke neeche. Side plank obliques ko BINA mota kiye tight karta hai — isi liye weighted side bends nahi (waist chaudi karke X-frame kharab karte hain).

static.target: Hamstrings — pair seedha, hips se aage jhuk.

warmup.why: Shoulder joint mein garmi.

warmup.name: Shoulder dislocates (towel/band/rod)
warmup.why: Kandhe ke saare angles khulte hain, chest bhi stretch. Naam se dar mat.

warmup.name: Band pull-aparts

warmup.name: Wall slides

warmup.name: Open-close hugs (arm swings)
warmup.why: Chest ka dynamic stretch.

warmup.name: Push-ups

warmup.name: Wrist circles + halki wrist stretch
warmup.why: Pressing ka saara load wrist se guzarta hai.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.form: Bench ~30°, forearms hamesha vertical, dumbbells chest ke upar milao (takraane nahi), control se neeche. Aesthetic chest yahi banata hai — flat bench upper hissa poora nahi bharta.
exercises.mistakes: Bench 45°+ karna — tab shoulder zyada khaata hai, chest kam.

exercises.name: Pec Deck / Cable Fly
exercises.form: Elbows halke bent aur FIX, haath hug karne jaisa milao.
exercises.mistakes: Bhaari leke elbow ka angle badalna.

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Press (barbell/machine)
exercises.form: Core tight, ribs neeche, lower back over-arch nahi, upar full press.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.form: X-frame ki chaudai yahi muscle hai. Elbows se lead, shoulder height tak, elbow ka halka bend poore rep mein SAME. Cable = constant tension.

exercises.name: Overhead DB Triceps Extension
exercises.form: Arm ka sabse bada hissa long head hai aur ye sirf overhead position mein full stretch hota hai. Elbows kaano ke paas, sirf forearm chale.
exercises.mistakes: Elbows bahar phailna; kohni ka hilna.

exercises.name: Rope Pushdown
exercises.form: Elbows body se fix, neeche full lockout squeeze, rope ends alag karo bottom pe.
exercises.mistakes: Kandhe aage jhuka ke body ka weight lagana.

week.title: PULL (Back, Rear Delts, Biceps)
week.crowdNote: Aaj bros ka shoulder day → lat pulldown, rows, pull-up station khali.

warmup.name: Arm circles + shoulder rolls
warmup.why: Shoulder garam.

warmup.name: Band pull-aparts
warmup.why: Roz ka ritual — rear delt kabhi thanda nahi jaana chahiye.

warmup.name: Cat-cow + T-spine rotation (open book)
warmup.why: Rowing ke liye upper spine ka ghumav zaroori.

warmup.name: Dead hang
warmup.why: Lats stretch + spine decompress + grip warm — pull day ka perfect starter.

warmup.name: Scapular pulls
warmup.why: Dead hang mein bina kohni mode kandhe neeche kheencho — lats ko ON karna sikhata hai; pull-up ka pehla step.

warmup.name: Wrist/forearm circles
warmup.why: Curls + grip ke liye.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-up / Close-grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.form: Har hafte assist weight thoda kam kar. Target: month 3 mein pehla bina-support pull-up.

exercises.name: Chest-supported Row
exercises.form: Chest pad pe — cheating impossible, beginner ke liye best. Elbow peeche kheench, 1 sec squeeze. (Barbell Row option: back flat, jerk nahi.)
exercises.mistakes: Jhatke se poora body hilana (barbell version mein back round karna).

exercises.name: One-arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.form: Ek haath-ghutna bench pe, pith table jaisi FLAT, elbow hip ki taraf kheench, torso square rahe.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.form: Chhupa hua hero: 3D kandhe peeche se bante hain + desk-job wali aage jhuki posture repair + shoulder injury insurance. Rope aankhon ke level pe, elbows HIGH (kandhon se upar), ends ko alag kheench, finish 'double biceps pose' jaisa.
exercises.mistakes: Heavy leke isko row bana dena. 90% log yahi galat karte hain.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrug
exercises.form: Neck ke side ka muscle jo collar se dikhta hai. Kandhe seedhe UPAR, top pe 1 sec hold, control se neeche.
exercises.mistakes: Kandhe gol-gol ghumana — bekar aur risky.

exercises.name: EZ-bar Curl
exercises.form: Elbows body ke saath FIX, poora range — neeche full stretch, upar squeeze.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
primary: Brachialis (biceps ke neeche — arm ki motai)
exercises.form: Neutral grip (hatheliyan aamne-saamne), elbows steady, control se.

exercises.form: Monday se thoda zyada weight, form bilkul same. Control se neeche, knees lock nahi.
exercises.mistakes: Weight ke chakkar mein range chhoti karna.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges

exercises.form: Dono ghutne 90°, aage wala knee panje ke UPAR (aage nahi), torso seedha khada, peeche wala ghutna zameen ko bas touch kare.

exercises.name: Leg Extension

exercises.form: Top pe 1 sec squeeze, control se neeche.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.form: Seated angle lying se alag stretch deta hai — Monday lying tha, aaj seated. Control se curl.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
primary: Soleus (calf ka neeche wala muscle — sirf bent-knee mein lagta hai)
exercises.form: Monday standing = gastro, aaj seated = soleus. Calf complete. Upar 1 sec, neeche full stretch.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise

exercises.form: Pelvis ko UPAR curl kar — sirf taange mat jhula.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch

exercises.mistakes: Hips se jhukna (spine round nahi karna).

exercises.mistakes: Jhuk ke chalna. (Jagah na ho toh: khade hoke 30–40 sec heavy DB hold — same kaam.)

exercises.backup: DB Bench ya Machine Chest Press (bench busy ho toh)

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown

exercises.mistakes: Peeche jhool ke momentum se kheenchna.

exercises.mistakes: Jhatka maar ke poora body aage-peeche hilana.

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raise
exercises.form: Halka aur clean. Elbow ka bend fix, wrist elbow se neeche nahi, shoulder height tak — dumbbell aur elbow lagbhag ek line.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.form: Aage se kandha bada, peeche se flat — wo adhoora look ab nahi. Arms khol ke peeche squeeze, weight halka.

exercises.name: Superset: DB Curl + Rope Pushdown

1 kela + muthi bhar peanuts ya peanut-butter bread

regular.note: Ye bina whey ke ~100–110 g protein deta hai. Fiber system roz chalu: papita, dahi, salad, paani — tera pet already bata chuka hai use kya chahiye.

veg.label: Veg Month
veg.targets: ~2,500 kcal | Protein ~115–125 g/day | Paani 3–4 L (dal-soya zyada hoga, paani aur zaroori warna bloating)

meals.food: Dal 2 katori + roti/rice + sabzi + dahi 1 katori
1 kela + muthi bhar peanuts, ya sattu shake (30 g sattu + paani + nimbu)
Soya chunks 50 g dry (sabzi/pulao) + 2 roti + salad + papita

veg.note: 100 g toh aaram se cross — buffer bhi hai. Agar ande allowed hain toh bata dena, kaam aur easy. Paneer mehenga pade toh 100 g roz ki jagah alternate days + us din soya 75 g — protein same.

budget.item: Paneer (3 kg — local dairy se loose, packet se sasta)
Dahi (ya doodh se ghar pe jamao — free jaisa)
Whey + creatine already paas hain — is mahine budget aaram se fit

veg.priority: Veg month mein creatine AUR ZYADA important — natural creatine meat se milta hai; veg log supplement se sabse zyada fayda uthate hain. Timing perfect hai.

supplements.name: Creatine monohydrate
supplements.detail: 3–5 g HAR ROZ (rest day bhi), kisi bhi time, paani ke saath — paani zyada pee. Sabse research-backed supplement; strength aur size dono mein farak dikhega.

supplements.name: Whey (25 g protein/scoop)
supplements.detail: 1 scoop post-workout, 250 ml doodh mein. 1 kg pack lagbhag poora mahina. Rest days pe bhi le sakta hai agar khana kam pada ho.

supplementsPriority: Priority order: Khaana pehle, phir creatine, phir whey.

lifestyle.cardio: Roz 8,000–10,000 steps (office walk + dinner ke baad 15 min). Sat: brisk/incline walk option. Spot reduction jhooth hai — fat calorie balance se jaayega, walking usko support karti hai + digestion sudharti hai.
lifestyle.sleep: 11–11:30 tak bed, minimum 7 ghante. Muscle gym mein tootta hai, neend mein banta hai.
smoking: Cigarette oxygen aur recovery loot rahi hai — stamina down, pump down, recovery slow. Quit ka decision teri profile ka best decision hai.
Pehla target: khaane ke baad + gym ke baad wali cigarette ko 10-min walk se replace kar.
Is mahine count AADHA kar. 5-day training pe cigarette ka tax double lagta hai.
35 saal ka pattern: jaise-jaise gym mein strong hoga, cigarette apne aap kamzor padegi.

tracking.start: Day 1: photo le (front + side), same lighting mein rakhna aage bhi.
tracking.biweekly: Har 2 hafte: waist tape navel pe + subah khaali pet weight.
tracking.perfectRecomp: Weight stable ya +0.5 kg/month max, waist same ya girti hui.
tracking.adjust: Belly badhe toh roti/rice thoda kam. Weight na badhe 4+ hafte toh khana thoda badha.
tracking.sundayReport: Sunday raat: hafte ki report — kaunsi exercise mein form ka doubt laga, wahi pehle polish hogi.
tracking.mindset: NEVER MISS TWICE. Ek din chhoota — agla din pakka, 30 min hi sahi.

references.muscleWiki: MuscleWiki: musclewiki.com — body ka diagram, muscle pe click → us muscle ki saari exercises video ke saath + primary/secondary muscles likhe hue. App bhi hai. HAR exercise ka photo+video+diagram ek jagah, free.
references.youtube: YouTube: Har exercise ke saath diya 'Video' link YouTube search kholta hai — top result koi bhi 1-min technique video dekh le. Search pattern: '[exercise name] proper form'.
references.camera: Camera: Sabse bada pro move: apna set phone pe record kar (side angle) aur reference se compare kar. Aaina jhooth bolta hai, camera nahi.
references.charts: Charts: Dynamic warm-up chart + full-body stretching chart (e.g. DAREBEE ke free charts) print karke gym bag mein rakh le.

closing: Ab isme sochne wala kaam khatam — sirf karne wala baaki. Never miss twice. — Coach
